quote: For an autonomous agent for EDA flow automation, users can provide the EDA task in natural language, and the agent will generate executable scripts to complete the EDA task via an LLM.
ChatEDA uses LLMs as "brains" of the agent to generate EDA scripts, automating EDA tool utilization, reducing the workload of circuit design engineers, and minimizing errors.

We develop the ChipLlama-powered agent, collaborating with few-shot CoT prompts, to develop the performance and portability of the single-agent system; • Propose EDAid, a multi-agent system that collaborates multiple agents including divergentthoughts agents and a decision-making agent for EDA flow automation; • Perform extensive evaluations, which demonstrate the SOTA performance of ChipLlama models, the effectiveness of the few-shot CoT prompting, and the superior performance of our EDAid for EDA flow automation.
